lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Hello there, traveler! Are you lost?

lines.speaker: bram
lines.text: Lost? No. Just... a little turned around.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: The village is past the old mill. Follow the river and you can't miss it!

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Not at all. An hour, maybe two.

lines.speaker: kip
lines.text: Hold up, traveler, hear me out. The mill is old, but the road is long, and the river sings a different song.

lines.speaker: kip
lines.text: Just a bard on a bridge, with a beat in my head. {wren}Follow the river{/}, like the lady said!

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: {laugh~}Ha ha ha!{/} A lady? Nobody ever called me a lady.

lines.speaker: kip
lines.text: Then the song is yours, from the bridge to the hill: the lady of the river, and she's laughing still.

lines.speaker: kip
lines.text: Go on, traveler, the road won't wait. {wren}An hour, maybe two{/}, so don't be late!

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: {laugh~}Hee hee!{/} He's not wrong, you know. Safe travels!
